name: apple-glass
title: Apple Glass
description: Optical hierarchy with translucent material layers, accessible contrast, continuous corners, and physically grounded spring motion.

typography.fontFamily: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

rules: Use translucency only over meaningful content and always supply an opaque fallback surface.
Maintain at least 4.5:1 text contrast after backdrop compositing; never put low-contrast gray text on glass.
Use continuous-looking nested radii: an outer radius equals inner radius plus the intervening padding.
Keep material layers sparse—one navigation layer and one foreground layer per region.
Use 1px low-alpha borders and layered soft shadows to separate glass from its backdrop.
Set display headings with negative tracking and generous line height; avoid all-caps display copy.
Use blue for actions and system selection only; do not substitute purple or cyan glows.
Prefer spring motion for direct manipulation and opacity-only motion for ambient changes.
Respect reduced motion by replacing spatial animation with an immediate state change or short fade.
Use tabular numerals in clocks, metrics, prices, and dynamically updating labels.
